capabilities.description: Move the observable arm tool to a bounded world position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: tasks/catalog.json mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint supplies the exact public criterion <= 0.05 m. Real instance kinova-gen3-robotiq-2f85-mw_reach_target in assets/reach_scene.xml supplies target [0.55, 0.1, 0.43] and its declared reset places site pinch_site at [0.289501817912, -0.498731652404, 0.433724312047] m. Request bounds are the exact coordinate-wise reset/target envelope; nominal is the deterministic midpoint and calibrated-boundary is the package target. Duration bounds are timestep 0.002 s through instance timeout 20 s; both cases receive that same timeout so difficulty differs only by target. The midpoint is a fixed protocol formula, not empirical calibration.

capabilities.effect: Requested displacement of body bracelet_link within the public reach tolerance.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: The same public mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint tolerance is <= 0.05 m. Real reset-to-target vector [0.260498182088, 0.598731652404, -0.00372431204697] has length 0.652956939593 m and normalized world direction [0.398951548399, 0.916954267731, -0.00570376363454]. Cases request exactly 50% and 100% of that measured vector length; the trusted operator measures requested displacement error, not mere positive progress. The 50% point is a declared protocol choice, not empirical calibration.

capabilities.description: Set the observable gripper joint position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: Real scene assets/reach_scene.xml declares joint left_driver_joint with exact rad range [0, 0.8], and the declared reset resolves to 0. Request bounds are narrowed to the measured nominal/boundary envelope [0.4, 0.8]. Real trusted actuator fingers_actuator was evaluated from declared reset 0 toward both exact MJCF limits: target 0: terminal 0.00260886091888, error 0.00260886091888, actual displacement 0.00260886091888, executable=False; target 0.8: terminal 0.786889709233, error 0.0131102907668, actual displacement 0.786889709233, executable=True. The farther executable limit 0.8 is boundary; nominal is its reset midpoint 0.4. Three real reset/controller/physics repeats per case produced errors [0.000661328120903415, 0.000661328120903415, 0.000661328120903415] and [0.013110290766808141, 0.013110290766808141, 0.013110290766808141]. experiment/experiment3/fixed_inputs/calibration_report.json#robots/kinova_gen3_robotiq_2f85/capabilities/C3 seals max error plus 64 * IEEE-754 binary64 epsilon * max(1, abs(lower), abs(upper), span) = 0.0131102907668 rad; this remains below nominal reset displacement 0.4. Selected constant controls were nominal 127.001953125 and boundary 255.
